# Jotform

> > Jotform is a no-code online form builder and workflow automation platform for creating registration forms, surveys, payment collection forms, and business applications.

Jotform provides drag-and-drop form creation tools with integrations to Google, Apple, and other platforms, enabling businesses to automate workflows, collect payments, and manage data without coding expertise.
